name: LIGHTINTHEBOX HLDGS S.ADR
summary: LIGHTINTHEBOX HLDGS S.ADR is an online retail company that sells a wide variety of products, including apparel, electronics, and home goods, directly to consumers around the world. The company utilizes a data-driven business model and offers its products through its LightInTheBox and MiniInTheBox websites. LightInTheBox is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
